chunk_findings.detail: This is presented as the regression for Be585bd4631 (`cadence --ran` of an unknown name must fail), but `test_a_calendar_name_from_every_days_is_still_recorded` only asserts that `--ran foo` exits OK after `every_days = ["foo=7"]`. On the unfixed code that appends a run for any string, that same call already exits 0 and prints `recorded cadence run: foo`, so the test passes before any fix. Closing the bug with this test (`--regression-test`) would mark Be585bd4631 fixed while `cadence --ran NOPE` still succeeds and the real pass stays due.
